_published_faq.name: How do I add Supermetrics Marketing Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Supermetrics Marketing Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.supermetrics.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Supermetrics Marketing Analytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Supermetrics Marketing Analytics lists 14 MCP tools, including data_source_discovery, accounts_discovery, field_discovery, data_query, get_async_query_results, get_today, contact_supermetrics, manage_user_and_team, campaign_and_resource_get, campaign_create, campaign_update, and resources_manage.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Supermetrics Marketing Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Supermetrics Marketing Analytics in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Supermetrics Marketing Analytics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Supermetrics Marketing Analytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Supermetrics Marketing Analytics is developed by Supermetrics. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
